tt-a1i/archify.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
score_reasons: topics: agent-skills, architecture-as-code, architecture-diagram, claude-skill, code-visualization
tt-a1i/archify.readme_summary: **Turn a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map — directly in chat.**
readme_features: Layout judgment over generic auto-layout — the agent chooses hierarchy, spacing, routes, and emphasis; shared automatic endpoints spread deterministically instead of piling arrows on one midpoint.
Typed JSON IR — every renderer-backed mode has a schema and reproducible source.
Atomic validation before delivery — schema, layout, HTML/SVG, route, and label-to-route clearance checks must all pass before a showcase artifact replaces the last known good output.

Failures come with a repair receipt — validate --json and deliver --json return stable rule codes, the exact subject, measured evidence, and only supported repair controls instead of a Node stack or an unstructured retry guess.

Last-good live preview — an optional desktop loop watches one JSON file, refreshes only after the latest candidate passes every gate, and keeps the previous verified diagram visible when a save is incomplete or invalid.

analysis.positioning: Archify 是一个面向编码代理的 Agent skill，用于将代码库或系统描述转化为美观、可验证的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图等，输出为自包含的 HTML 文件，支持动态效果和清晰导出。它强调布局判断、类型化 JSON 中间表示和原子化验证，与普通图表工具相比，更注重生成过程的可靠性和可修复性。
target_users: 使用 Claude、Codex、OpenCode 等编码代理的开发者，希望在对话中直接生成系统架构图。
需要将代码库或系统设计文档转化为可视化图表的软件架构师和技术文档编写者。
在 CI/CD 或开发工作流中需要自动化生成和验证架构图的团队。
core_capabilities: 智能布局判断：代理根据内容选择层级、间距、路由和强调，共享端点自动分散，避免箭头堆积。
类型化 JSON 中间表示：每种渲染模式都有 schema，保证可复现性。
原子化验证：交付前进行 schema、布局、HTML/SVG、路由和标签-路由冲突检查，确保输出质量。
失败修复收据：提供稳定的规则代码、精确主题和测量证据，支持受控修复。
最后良好预览：桌面循环监视 JSON 文件，仅在最新候选通过所有检查后刷新，保留上一个有效图表。
